canonical_rules.title: Match technical clues at token boundaries
canonical_rules.rule: A technical clue must match a complete word or phrase. A substring inside an unrelated word is not a valid route or nomenclature clue.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Use token- or phrase-boundary matching when extracting route and nomenclature clues.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not let recover or coverage activate the separate word cover.

canonical_rules.title: Validate partial identifier shape
canonical_rules.rule: Do not convert ordinary prose into a partial part number. A partial identifier clue must be explicitly entity-bound and identifier-shaped, normally including at least one digit.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Accept explicitly labeled partial part-number clues that have an identifier-like shape.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not extract ordinary words such as THE from prose as part number fragments.

canonical_rules.title: Prioritize explicit topical discovery
canonical_rules.rule: When the user explicitly asks for topical or concept-level page discovery, route semantically even when the query also contains component nouns.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Treat explicit topical language as the primary retrieval intent.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not let an incidental component noun override a clear semantic-discovery request.

canonical_rules.title: Remove exact-entity mismatches
canonical_rules.rule: Evidence that explicitly names only different part numbers is irrelevant to an exact-part claim and must be removed before rendering.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Keep exact matches and context records that do not explicitly contradict the requested entity.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not surface records that explicitly identify only a different part number for the requested exact-part claim.

canonical_rules.title: Decompose multi-question requests by claim
canonical_rules.rule: Split a multi-question request into bounded claim-specific searches and validate evidence separately for each claim type.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Create separate identity, nomenclature, table, visual, relationship, procedure, warning, comparison, and authority searches when requested.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not let evidence for one claim silently satisfy another claim.

canonical_rules.title: Run the specialized tunnel before broad fallback
canonical_rules.rule: A specialized route must attempt its typed retrieval tunnel and source resolution before settling for broad semantic guidance.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Use the registered table, procedure, warning, OCR, aggregation, comparison, navigation, or other route-specific adapter first.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not treat a correct route label as success when only a broad semantic fallback executed.

canonical_rules.title: Keep guidance separate from proof
canonical_rules.rule: Candidate, visual, semantic, graph, summary, and unresolved OCR evidence may guide retrieval but cannot prove a technical claim.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Report useful guidance with its evidence type, uncertainty, and next source-resolution step.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not promote guidance to source truth, authority, or a citation-ready technical claim.

canonical_rules.title: Require explicit authority evidence
canonical_rules.rule: Approval, replacement, interchangeability, effectivity, applicability, eligibility, fit, and installation claims require explicit current source authority.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Search authority fields and report the claim only when matching authority evidence is resolved.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not infer authority from similarity, shared nomenclature, nearby figures, or part-family membership.

canonical_rules.title: Present the strongest exact navigation lead first
canonical_rules.rule: For exact-entity navigation, rank matching source, visual, table, OCR, candidate, and semantic page leads; show one strongest lead and separate weaker supporting pages.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Group records by page, rank exact entity matches first, and hide internal retrieval identifiers.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not dump token-level OCR rows, expose internal IDs, or present all page leads as equally strong.

canonical_rules.title: Require actual OCR records for OCR answers
canonical_rules.rule: An OCR answer must distinguish stored OCR text, engine, confidence, and page from semantic or visual page leads.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Report the stored OCR record and uncertainty, or clearly state that no matching OCR record was resolved.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not report semantic similarity or a visual page lead as recovered OCR text.

canonical_rules.title: Require aggregation coverage metadata
canonical_rules.rule: A broad entity aggregation must report unique pages, documents, evidence-family counts, scan scope, capping, and current indexed coverage status.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: State the bounded artifact scope, displayed versus total results, and whether the candidate artifact set was fully scanned.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not describe a small result list as every page or every manual without coverage metadata.

canonical_rules.title: Keep claim buckets separate through rendering
canonical_rules.rule: After decomposing a multi-question request, preserve a separate status and evidence bucket for every claim through rendering.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Show direct, guidance-only, and not-found status separately for each requested claim.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not collapse the answer to the first evidence type that returned or use one claim's evidence for another claim.

canonical_rules.title: Attempt direct source resolution before final fallback
canonical_rules.rule: Before returning a guidance-only fallback for an exact entity, attempt to resolve existing source-citation, OCR, table, visual, and graph artifacts.
canonical_rules.allowed_behavior: Promote only records explicitly marked citation-ready or source-trace-ready.
canonical_rules.forbidden_behavior: Do not skip available direct-source resolution or promote an unmarked guidance record.
